faq.question: What services does PLS Accounting provide?
faq.answer: PLS Accounting, Prime Ledger Solution for Accounting Services, provides accounting and bookkeeping, financial advisory and business consulting support in the UAE. Dr. Ahmad Helwani’s UAE Taxes website explains his VAT and Corporate Tax guidance.

faq.question: What should I prepare before making an enquiry?
faq.answer: Share your business activity, the service or question involved, the relevant period and any approaching deadline. Explain which accounts, invoices or other supporting records are available. You can make an enquiry before every document has been gathered.

faq.question: What does Dr. Ahmad Helwani’s VAT review include?
faq.answer: You receive a written explanation of the issue reviewed, any unresolved information gaps and the recommended next steps. The scope of Dr. Ahmad Helwani’s VAT review is discussed using the transaction details and available supporting records.

faq.question: How can I contact PLS Accounting?
faq.answer: Email ah@pls-uae.com with a short description of your business question. Enquiries can be made in English or Arabic.
